title: 为什么吃得“差”反而更胖？
title_en: Why does eating 'badly' make you fatter?

segments.zh: 同样一桌饭，同样的热量，
segments.en: Same meals, same calories on the plate,

segments.zh: 有人一天多吃了五百大卡。
segments.en: and people ate 500 extra calories a day.

segments.zh: 今天的微博热搜：原来吃得差才会胖。
segments.en: Today on Weibo's hot list: 'eating badly is what makes you fat.'

segments.zh: 热度三千三百万。
segments.en: 33 million in heat.

segments.zh: 说法是：牛肉鸡蛋不是元凶，
segments.en: The claim: beef and eggs aren't the culprits.

segments.zh: 蛋糕奶茶才是。
segments.en: Cake and milk tea are.

segments.zh: 今天的问题：一样多的热量，
segments.en: Today's question: with the same calories,

segments.zh: 为什么吃得“差”就会胖？
segments.en: why does eating 'badly' make you fatter?

segments.zh: 先认识小胃。
segments.en: Meet Tummy.

segments.zh: 它每天只问一句话：吃饱了吗？
segments.en: It asks one thing all day: am I full yet?

segments.zh: 二零一九年，美国国立卫生研究院做了一个实验。
segments.en: In 2019, the US National Institutes of Health ran an experiment.

segments.zh: 二十个人，住进医院，整整四个星期。
segments.en: Twenty people lived in a hospital for four weeks.

segments.zh: 两周吃超加工食品，
segments.en: Two weeks of ultra-processed food,

segments.zh: 两周吃少加工的天然食物。
segments.en: two weeks of minimally processed food.

segments.zh: 关键是：两种饭端上来的热量、糖、脂肪、纤维，
segments.en: The key: both diets served the same calories, sugar, fat and fiber.

segments.zh: 全都一样。
segments.en: Exactly matched.

segments.zh: 想吃多少吃多少，没人逼。
segments.en: Eat as much as you like. Nobody's forcing anyone.

segments.zh: 结果：超加工那两周，每人每天多吃了大约五百大卡。
segments.en: Result: on ultra-processed food, people ate about 500 calories more per day.

segments.zh: 差不多两碗米饭。
segments.en: Roughly two bowls of rice.

segments.zh: 两周下来，平均胖了将近一公斤。
segments.en: In two weeks they gained almost a kilo on average.

segments.zh: 换成天然食物，又瘦了差不多那么多。
segments.en: On the natural diet, they lost about the same.

segments.zh: 反转一：大家给两种饭打分，一样好吃。
segments.en: Twist one: people rated both diets equally tasty.

segments.zh: 不是因为更香，才多吃。
segments.en: It wasn't about flavor.

segments.zh: 那多出来的五百大卡，
segments.en: So where did those extra 500 calories

segments.zh: 到底是从哪来的？
segments.en: come from?

segments.zh: 线索一：吃得更快。
segments.en: Clue one: people ate faster.

segments.zh: 超加工食品又软又好嚼，几口就下去了。
segments.en: Soft, easy-to-chew food goes down in a few bites.

segments.zh: 而“吃饱了”的信号，从肠子传到大脑，
segments.en: And the 'I'm full' signal takes time

segments.zh: 要花上一段时间。
segments.en: to travel from the gut to the brain.

segments.zh: 就像外卖小哥送一张“够了”的纸条。
segments.en: It's like a courier delivering a note that says 'enough.'

segments.zh: 你吃得太快，纸条还没到，饭已经光了。
segments.en: Eat too fast, and the plate is empty before the note arrives.

segments.zh: 线索二：热量密度。
segments.en: Clue two: energy density.

segments.zh: 同样一口，超加工食品塞进去的热量更多。
segments.en: Each bite of processed food packs in more calories.

segments.zh: 一块蛋糕和一盘青菜，个头差不多，
segments.en: A slice of cake and a plate of greens look about the same size,

segments.zh: 热量估计能差十倍。
segments.en: but the calories can differ roughly tenfold.

segments.zh: 而胃觉得饱，很大一部分是靠被撑开。
segments.en: And a stomach feels full largely by being stretched.

segments.zh: 它不太会数热量。
segments.en: It's bad at counting calories.

segments.zh: 反转二：吃天然食物的那两周，
segments.en: Twist two: on the natural diet,

segments.zh: 让人饱的激素升高了，让人饿的激素降了。
segments.en: a fullness hormone went up and a hunger hormone went down.

segments.zh: 也就是说，吃天然食物，
segments.en: In other words, on real food,

segments.zh: 身体自己会踩刹车。
segments.en: the body hits its own brakes.

segments.zh: 反转三：“吃得差”说的不是吃得少，也不是穷，
segments.en: Twist three: 'eating badly' isn't about eating little, or being poor.

segments.zh: 而是食物被加工得太“省事”了。
segments.en: It's food processed to be too effortless.

segments.zh: 工厂把嚼、剥、消化的活儿，
segments.en: The factory has already done the chewing, peeling and breaking down

segments.zh: 提前帮你干完了。
segments.en: for you.

segments.zh: 对你的牙是省事了，
segments.en: Easy on your teeth.

segments.zh: 对你的腰可就不省事了。
segments.en: Not so easy on your waistline.

segments.zh: 奶茶为什么喝了不觉得饱？
segments.en: Why doesn't milk tea fill you up?

segments.zh: 不少研究认为，喝下去的热量，大脑最容易漏算。
segments.en: Many studies suggest the brain undercounts calories you drink.

segments.zh: 那牛肉鸡蛋呢？蛋白质让人饱得更久，
segments.en: And beef and eggs? Protein keeps you full longer,

segments.zh: 同样的热量，更难吃过头。
segments.en: so the same calories are harder to overeat.

segments.zh: 所以热搜那句话，大方向是对的：
segments.en: So the hot take is roughly right:

segments.zh: 胖不胖，不只看吃多少，还看吃的是什么。
segments.en: it's not only how much you eat, but what kind.

segments.zh: 但别把它理解成“蛋糕有毒”。
segments.en: But it doesn't mean cake is poison.

segments.zh: 热量还是热量。
segments.en: A calorie is still a calorie.

segments.zh: 只不过超加工食品，
segments.en: Ultra-processed food just makes it

segments.zh: 让人特别容易多吃。
segments.en: really easy to eat more.

segments.zh: 友情提示：这只是一项二十个人、四周的小实验，
segments.en: Friendly fine print: this was a small study, 20 people, four weeks.

segments.zh: 结论还要更多研究，每个人也不一样。
segments.en: More research is needed, and everyone's different.

segments.zh: 身体有问题，听医生的，
segments.en: For health questions, listen to your doctor,

segments.zh: 别听热搜的，也别听一块白板的。
segments.en: not a hot list, and not a whiteboard.

segments.zh: 最后送一个小建议：吃慢一点，
segments.en: One last tip: eat a little slower,

segments.zh: 让“够了”的纸条，追上你的筷子。
segments.en: so the 'enough' note can catch up with your chopsticks.

segments.zh: 小胃说：我不是不饱，
segments.en: Tummy says: I'm not never full.

segments.zh: 我只是消息慢。
segments.en: My messages are just slow.
